# Global News Map

> Today's headlines from local news outlets worldwide, on an interactive map.
> 233 validated RSS feeds across 141 countries, grouped continent > region >
> country > news sources. Headlines refresh daily (~06:20 America/Los_Angeles).

## What it is

An interactive world map where clicking a continent, region, or country shows
the latest headlines from that place's local news outlets. Every headline
links out to the original publisher article.

- Interactive map: https://globalnewsmap.net/
- Plain headline list (no JavaScript needed): https://globalnewsmap.net/top
- Per-country shareable pages: https://globalnewsmap.net/country/<slug>
  (e.g. https://globalnewsmap.net/country/south-korea)
- Per-region shareable pages: https://globalnewsmap.net/region/<slug>
  (e.g. https://globalnewsmap.net/region/southeast-asia)

## Data API (JSON, no key required)

- GET /api/top-headlines?limit=15 — freshest headlines worldwide (max 50)
- GET /api/headlines?continent=<slug>&limit=15 — e.g. ?continent=europe
- GET /api/headlines?region=<slug>&limit=15 — e.g. ?region=southeast-asia
- GET /api/headlines?country=<admin-name>&limit=15 — e.g. ?country=South%20Korea
- GET /api/hierarchy — the continent > region > country > sources tree
- GET /api/status — crawl health: story counts and last fetch time per continent

Each headline object has: title, url, source (outlet name), summary (when the
feed provides one), published_at, fetched_at.

## Attribution

Headlines belong to their publishers. When citing a story, link to the
headline's `url` (the original article), and name the outlet from `source`.

## Limits

- Headlines update once daily; "today" means the most recent daily crawl.
- Three countries have no local feed coverage by editorial choice (Bahrain,
  Mongolia, North Korea) and show no headlines.
- Summaries are only present when the source RSS feed includes them.
